message: Thinking it was worth tutoring her, I peek at Azel's test sheet.
It's barely above a failing grade, though this is......

name: Azel
message: 「Just as you aimed, I conquered the multiple-choice questions, kanji, and chemical formulas」
Her math score is unexpectedly bad, though it was weirdly hard.
Sengenin-sensei put way too much effort into it for a student teacher.

name: Sacchin
message: 「I lost in both score and attitude~」

name: Eddie
message: 「What a confident attitude! I lost! I lost on score too! Complete defeat!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, where's Nanaka?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The second break started, she left the classroom. She went to dig a hole in the corner of the schoolyard to bury her test sheet~」
Still, was it really bad enough to warrant saying that...
Azel suddenly snatched my test away.

name: Azel
message: 「Since he refuses to show anyone, the score must not be anything impressive」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun's test paper is bad for the eyes~ He got 7th in the grade~」

name: Synn
message: 「Who rips something just because they felt like it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I get it~ You just randomly get the urge to rip it up~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even I went to the corner of the schoolyard to bury my returned test!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, I stopped after seeing Treasurer get scolded by Sengen'in-sensei. A wise person stays away from suspicious life buoys, after all. If you cling to a sinking buoy, you'll sink right along with it」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, did you do badly on the test?」
I snatched the test paper just before Azel could tear it up and handed it back to Misa.

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think it's a bad enough score to put you in a mood, though」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that supposed to be a victory speech?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Miss Hissy Fit here is just mad 'cause she got a lower score than Master Synn.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. I-It's not like I'm bitter or anything! I just happened to place 8th by pure coincidence!」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um... the Holy Night Festival is coming up soon, isn't it\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! The Holy Night Festival, the Holy Night Festival! We're marchin' onward toward the future!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! We mustn't look back on the past!」

name: Synn
message: 「...How about we head somewhere else for a change of pace?」
